summary: ```markdown # CLO Skills Mini-Class - Replacing Panel Pieces ## Introduction Today, I will introduce a small technique for changing the version of a garment. ## Overview of the Modification Now, I see a set of clothes that we have made. I want to adjust the shirt by adding the modified shirt version. You can see the straight line of the version after the modification. The number of straight lines of the original version is different. ## Version Replacement Condition The condition for version replacement is no longer limited by the number of straight lines; you can replace it directly. ## Starting the Replacement Process Next, we will start the replacement of the version: 1. Select the original version. 2. Right-click to replace. 3. Select the version after heavy adjustment. 4. Then select the corresponding points one by one. 5. Press the return button to replace. ## Finalizing the Replacement Then, replace the original version in the same way. Here, we will save the version that has been added. ## Properties Retained During Replacement The replacement involves adjusting the position of the straight line point of the version, including: - Curve - Cut - Base line - Version name and code information - Sewing line - Internal shape - Sticker - Fabric - Name line - Draw - Button All properties of the original version are retained. ## Modifying the Clothing Design Here, you can modify: - The shape of the clothing - The design of the front of the clothing - The size of the clothing - The length of the clothing ## Conclusion This is our introduction to the replacement function. Thank you for watching. ```
